result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mostly around card cropping at the screen edge and a truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: Third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name and delivery price truncated/hidden
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll container padding or clip so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability with partial peek design

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, suggesting cut-off text rather than intentional design
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis or ensure text truncation is clearly indicated

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) shows a partially cut-off item at the right edge, unclear if more categories exist
issues.suggestion: Add a visual fade or arrow indicator to show the row is scrollable

issues.description: Pizza promo card at the bottom is abruptly cropped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible text or details
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient spacing/padding above the bottom nav so cards aren't awkwardly cut off mid-content

issues.description: Heart icon on the pizza promo card has low contrast against the busy pizza image background
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle background circle or shadow behind icon buttons on image cards for better visibility and contrast
